latest_release.name: v1.12.0
latest_release.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release upgrades Node in the Docker image to 26.12.1 which fixes multiple recently disclosed [vulnerabilities](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v26.12.1.md). 
> It is recommended to update at the earliest opportunity.


## What's Changed

This release introduces personal documents - a private space for every user, alongside a large round of mobile polish, security hardening, and continued performance work on both the client and server.

### Highlights

* Every user now has a personal section for private documents in the sidebar in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14062 https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14187 (Admins can disable in settings)
* Drag and drop in the sidebar was rebuilt to be more responsive
* Mermaid diagrams are now faster, much prettier, and responsive as they are rendered with Pele in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14126 - 
* Passkey login is now possible inside the desktop app (Make sure you're running the latest version) in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14180 https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14241 https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14242

### MCP

* OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents are now supported for MCP clients in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14015
* Added a tool to show what changed in a document in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14192
* The MCP SDK has been upgraded to v2 with support for the 2026-07-28 protocol in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14244

### Performance improvements

* Editor UI now renders from observable state instead of `forceUpdate` in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14073
* Share popover and document meta chunks are now preloaded on predicted intent in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14125
* The document is no longer restyled on every frame of the sidebar animation in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14132
* Notification counts no longer use default scope joins in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14139
* Empty unfurl results are now remembered on the client in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14135
* The text column is now skipped when loading document lists in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14138
* Permanent Iframely errors are now cached for an hour in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14134
* Typing in large code blocks is faster in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14181
* `SearchIndexProcessor` jobs are no longer queued for the Postgres provider in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14186
* `SlackProcessor` now waits for a summary only after cheap checks pass in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14188
* Reduced traversals and skipped unneeded work in `ProsemirrorHelper` in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14243
* Attachments are now loaded in one query when signing urls in text in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14247
* Comment view lookups are now batched and email diff clipping is memoized in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14251
* Only the patched path is now copied when recreating transforms in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14250

### Other improvements

* Tables can now be placed inside notices in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14175
* Code block line numbers can now be shown alongside line wrapping in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14170
* The mobile sidebar can now be closed with a drag, and header controls are touch-friendly in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14179
* Emails now support one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14148
* A warning is now shown when theme colors have low contrast in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14258
* Headings are now weighted above body text in shared document search in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14087
* Postgres search now retries as a quoted query when there are no re
